notes.title: The Big Update! - Patch 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
[h3]This update marks a major milestone for [b]No Heroes Here 2[/b]. It introduces new features, significant improvements, and a wide range of fixes and enhancements inspired by community feedback![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924898/8d03c7f0f80bce2ff7c848eb05446ea786fae737.jpg[/img]
[h3]Progression just got more rewarding 🤝[/h3]
At Leo’s Shop, you can now spend a new currency earned by playing rounds to unlock content at your own pace. Choose which stations, kingdoms, characters, and castles to unlock, in the order that makes the most sense for your playstyle. You should shape your own journey, after all!

Players with a saved game file will retain all previously unlocked Characters, Weapons, and Kingdoms. Additionally, you’ll receive coins based on the number of runs in your save file, allowing you to continue progressing in Leo’s Shop without losing any of your achievements.

[h3]Refreshed Tutorial 💣[/h3]
We've added a revamped tutorial to help players better understand the game’s core mechanics and systems. Perfect for new players and a helpful refresher for veterans!

[h3]Improved Visual Feedback 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦[/h3]
[list]
[*] Item outlines have been refined for clarity. 
[*] The UI has been redesigned with a cleaner, more minimalistic approach to reduce on-screen clutter during gameplay. 
[*] Menus are now more intuitive and easier to navigate when selecting stations and items.
[/list]
[h3]Updated Difficulty Parameters ⚔️[/h3]
The round settings menu now offers a more intuitive way to adjust round length and difficulty, giving you better control over the game.
You can also choose which stations will appear in your next round. Choose wisely!

[h3]Enhanced Round Summary 🗺️[/h3]
Post-round feedback is now more personalized and informative. See who cleaned the most, who crafted the most, and decide who stood out as the team MVP.

[h3]Expanded Language Support 🌍[/h3]
No Heroes Here 2 is now localized in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean. Welcome to all our new players around the world!

[h3]Join our Community! 🏰 [/h3]
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. This update was shaped by community input during early access and public playtests. We’d love to hear what you think! Report bugs, share feedback and meet new players via [url="https://discord.com/invite/madmimic"]https://discord.com/invite/madmimic[/url].

notes.title: No Heroes Here 2 Release Date and New Demo Available!
notes.content:
We're in the final stretch before the official launch of No Heroes Here 2, and we're excited to finally reveal the long-awaited release date: [b]No Heroes Here 2 will be released on July 1st of this year![/b]

Until then, everyone can play an updated DEMO featuring the changes we've made over the past few months. This version is a sneak peek for those eager to dive into No Heroes Here 2! 

[previewyoutube=ObK8dGIZ9Ks;full][/previewyoutube]

Play as one of four unique characters, choose your preferred difficulty across three different castle layouts, and defend Noobland alongside your friends — all while manning the mighty cannon!

No Heroes Here 2 DEMO supports 1 to 4 players, in local multiplayer only. But don't worry: in the full version, you'll be able to enjoy online multiplayer, and a wide variety of new castles, characters, kingdoms, and weapons to enhance your adventure.

So go ahead and install the DEMO, add No Heroes Here 2 to your wishlist, and mark your calendar for the big launch on July 1st. We hope to see you there!

notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924898/84edfe0f938f2af8090f29c9fa2bcf8025bf3069.gif[/img]

Unleash your creativity and design the ultimate automated setup!

[list]

[/list]
[b]Castles[/b]
[list]

[/list]
[b]Stations[/b]

notes.title: No Heroes Here 2 Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Welcome to [i]No Heroes Here 2[/i] Early Access!

In No Heroes Here 2, a group of non-adventurers is the last hope in defending the castle in this chaotic co-op tower defense game with roguelike features. With up to 4 players, your party must organize the castle, work as a team to craft ammo, and shoot at enemies to protect your kingdom!

[previewyoutube=gxt2_VvKMmM;full][/previewyoutube]

We're excited to give you an early look at the game as we continue to develop and refine it with your feedback. In this first release, you’ll begin your adventure in the kingdom of Noobland, with six unique characters, two different types of weapons, and six castles to defend.

[b]Kingdoms[/b]
[list]
[*] Noobland: a typical medieval kingdom characterized by its lush forests and serene landscapes.
[/list]
[b]Characters[/b]
[list]
[*] Princess
[*] Dancer
[*] Jester
[*] Priest
[*] Trainer 
[*] Blacksmith
[/list]
[b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Cannon: the traditional choice. Use iron and coal to produce cannonballs and fire them at invading enemies! 
[*] Slingshot: a more flexible option. Take your enemies down by using a rubber band and some stones!
[/list]
[b]Castles[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 easy, 2 normal and 2 hard Castles to explore!
[/list]
[b]Stations[/b]
[list]
[*] Basic and Advanced Counters
[*] Basic and Advanced Furnaces
[*] Well and Basic Bucket
[*] Storage
[*] Trash Bin
[/list]
New updates will roll out every three weeks, adding fresh content and features right up to launch in early 2025.

Make sure to join our discord server through the main menu to get in touch with our development team and community! So, gather your friends, choose your favorite character, and jump into the action. Ready to dive into No Heroes Here 2 Early Access? Let's go!

notes.title: NO HEROES HERE 2 DEMO AVAILABLE DURING STEAM NEXT FESTIVAL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44924898/9ca5fe7682f3e64e5ea7d3326d99f11e5df48cc6.png[/img]

For the first time in all of its development, players can download a demo of No Heroes Here 2 and play this chaotic co-op tower defense game with roguelike features. In the game, up to 4 players must prosper through 15 rounds against hordes of brute invaders by preparing the castle stations, reinforcing your defenses each day and choosing the best curveballs for each scenario.

While we finish working on the game content for full release, you already can play with a variety of characters, weapons and castles in the kingdom of Noobland. This demo will be available throughout Steam Next Fest (until Oct. 21st), but we're thrilled to announce the [b]launch date of No Heroes Here 2 Early Acess: October 29th![/b] 

Please don't forget to wishlist the game to stay tuned in the next announcements and updates, and [url=https://discord.gg/madmimic]join our Discord[/url] to meet new players and chat with the game developers. 

Have fun!
